## Release — backlog-campaign v0.17.0

### ✨ What's new in v0.17.0

Minor release focused on campaign resume safety, docs/quality gates, kaizen hunter
reliability, and a large modularization pass on the verify/build toolchain that landed
via the post-v0.16.0 kaizen wave.

#### Campaign UX

- **Routine-resume config confirmation (ADR-015)** — `/blackhole run` against an existing
  `.blackhole/config.json` no longer silently reuses the prior campaign settings. The
  coordinator prints `bun run status config-summary` and asks Proceed | Reconfigure before
  spawning the orchestrator.
- **AskQuestion payload contract** — clarify gates document the expected AskQuestion
  payload shape so harnesses and workers share one contract for product/UX blockers.

#### Quality gates & docs

- **`V-DOC-05` (WARN)** — reviewer emits a factual-accuracy finding when companion docs
  drift from code reality (distinct from structural companion-file audits).
- **`V-VOCAB-01` generalized** — vocabulary check covers a broader controlled lexicon across
  protocol docs and agent prompts.
- **ADR status enum** — frontmatter, `documentation/decisions/INDEX.md`, and body `Status`
  lines must agree on the Accepted/Proposed/… enum; verify fails on drift.
- **ADR-016** — story-driven conformance adoption recorded for how protocol stories map to
  verify checks.

#### Kaizen / hunter reliability

- **Hunter is a first-class campaign agent** — registered in `CAMPAIGN_AGENTS`, wired into
  the SubagentStop / validate-worker-json hook path, and covered by schema fixtures so
  hunter completions are no longer silent no-ops for resume/validation.
- **Doctor roster SSOT** — `EXPECTED_BC_AGENTS` derives from `AGENT_NAMES`, so doctor fails
  when router / investigator / hunter agent files are missing instead of greenwashing a
  five-agent subset.

#### Install & CI

- **skills.sh root agents** — build compiles root-level agent files into the skills.sh
  target so `{{AGENT_DIR}}` citations resolve correctly.
- **Stacked-PR CI** — verify runs on all `pull_request` targets (not only `main`), so
  stacked blackhole branches get CI before merge.
- **Self-hosted CI** — Bun setup/cache steps skipped on self-hosted runners where the
  toolchain is already present.

#### Toolchain modularization (kaizen wave)

- **`scripts/build.ts` split** into `scripts/lib/build/*`; consumers import modules directly.
- **Shared check bootstrap** — `check-utils` / `check-common` replace copy-pasted root /
  `CheckResult` / read helpers across domain `*.check.ts` files; frontmatter parsing
  consolidates on `parseMdFrontmatter`.
- **Worker-JSON / campaign-status / orchestrator splits** — large monoliths broken into
  focused modules with expanded unit and fixture coverage (verify runner, release CLI,
  playbook, checkpoint alignment, single-writer invariant, V-TOOLS-01 deny-matrix).
- **Deprecated build-flag gating removed** — `determineBuildTargets` / `runFullBuildOnce`
  no longer carry inert `--gemini` / `--all` / `--no-codex` fallbacks; plain `bun run build`
  is the path.
